'''Shield Generator Station 3''' was a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generator]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sheris]]. It was located outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Marter An]] and was the target of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ground force during an [[Battle of Sheris|assault on the planet]].<ref name="SWAJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Stand at Bhir'khi Pass (article)}}</ref>
